title: Sa dirmi, scusi, qual'è l'osteria
subtitle: Mimì at the toll gate asks for the tavern where Marcello paints, La bohème, Act 3

passages.label: Mimì comes in from the rue d'Enfer (Lento molto, F major)
Sa dirmi, scusi: the sergeant points out the tavern
O buona donna: the message for Marcello
The toll gate: an empty basket, and the bell for matins

licences.source: Luigi Illica and Giuseppe Giacosa, libretto of La bohème (1896)
licences.author: Luigi Illica (1857–1919) and Giuseppe Giacosa (1847–1906)
licences.notes: Words as printed in the Ricordi vocal score.

licences.source: G. Ricordi & C. vocal score of La bohème, pages 176-179 (from figure (6), page 176 system 4, to the end of page 179 system 2, before figure (8), 44 bars)
licences.author: Carlo Carignani (1857–1919), piano reduction
licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages: sung lines and piano each transcribed independently, disagreements settled on the page by a separate judge, then checked against the print and corrected. The offstage bell (Campanelle), printed under the piano's right hand and from page 179 on a small staff of its own, is played in the piano's right hand. Tempo from the printed relation Lento molto, half note = quaver, (the opening Andantino mosso's ♩ = 112, page 167) and the I.° Tempo; the Allegro and Andante are values chosen as stated in the piece's notes.
